Position: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

Department: Finance and Support Services

Reports To: Chief Executive Officer

Responsible For: All staff under the Finance and Support Services Department

No. of Openings: One (01)

1. Job purpose

Provide strategic financial leadership and support for the overall operation and effectiveness of the organization. Has primary day-to-day responsibility for planning, implementing, managing, and controlling all financial-related activities of the company. Has direct responsibility for accounting, finance, budgeting, strategic planning, costing, legal, property management, and deal analysis and negotiations. As a key member of the Executive Management team, he takes on a strategic role in the overall management of the company. This integral role will demand technical skills paired with strong leadership to help the continued growth of the airline.

2. Key responsibilities

In particular, he/she will;

(a) Financial and fiscal management

  • Be responsible for all financial and fiscal management aspects of company operations.
  • Be responsible for enhancing the cash position of the Company.
  • Be accountable for the development of a financial and operational strategy, metrics tied to that strategy, and the ongoing development and monitoring of control systems designed to preserve company assets and report accurate financial results.

(b) Business planning and budgeting

  • Provide strategic leadership and coordination in the development and implementation of the 5-year business plan, financial management, accounting, budgeting, program, and system management efforts of the company.
  • Oversee the preparation of the annual budget, monthly Profit and Loss, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow Statements.

(c) Financial systems, processing and reporting

  • Approve and coordinate changes and improvements in automated financial and management information systems for the company.
  • Oversee the approval processing of revenue, expenditure, and position control documents, department budgets, mass salary updates, ledger and account maintenance, and data entry.
  • Coordinate the preparation of financial statements, financial and management reports, special analyses, and information reports.

(d) Internal control, audit and asset protection

  • Ensure appropriate and robust finance, accounting, billing, and auditing procedures.
  • Ensure records systems are maintained in accordance with generally accepted financial standards, and assist in obtaining the necessary licenses and insurance required to operate the business.
  • Ensure safe keeping of all company assets and stores, periodic audit of stores, and that all assets are engraved.

(e) Procurement and Disposal Unit (PDU) and supply chain

  • Develop and implement purchasing and supply chain management.
  • Provide executive oversight of the Procurement and Disposal Unit (PDU), ensuring that procurement and disposal activities comply with the Public Procurement and Disposal of Public Assets (PPDA) Act, its regulations and the company’s procurement policies, while respecting the independence of the PDU and the Contracts Committee as required by law.
  • Oversee the preparation, consolidation and monitoring of the annual procurement plan, ensuring it is aligned with the approved budget and the 5-year business plan.
  • Ensure value for money, transparency and timely delivery in procurement, including sound contract management and monitoring of supplier performance.
  • Ensure that disposal of obsolete, surplus and unserviceable assets is carried out in line with approved procedures and properly recorded.
  • Ensure timely and accurate procurement reports to the Chief Executive Officer, the Board and regulatory authorities.

(f) Information Technology (IT)

  • Oversee the IT department and ensure full integration of the IT system.
  • Provide oversight of IT strategy and the IT budget, ensuring alignment with the company’s business plan and operational needs.
  • Oversee IT governance, information security, data protection, and business continuity and disaster recovery arrangements.
  • Provide oversight of IT projects, vendor contracts and service level agreements, ensuring delivery on time, within budget and to the required standard.
  • Ensure that finance, revenue accounting and other business systems are reliable, integrated and produce accurate data for decision-making.
  • Report on IT performance, risks and investments to the Chief Executive Officer and the Board.

(g) Executive leadership and people management

  • As a member of the Leadership team, contribute and work collaboratively with all elements of day-to-day airline operations, including employee and customer relations, safety, revenue management, scheduling, strategic alliances, sales, brand management, product development, and customer service delivery.
  • Carry out the staff appraisals for the department.

3. Minimum qualifications and experience

  • An Honours Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Accounting or Finance, or a closely related and relevant field, from a recognized University.
  • Full Accountancy professional qualification, such as ACCA and CPA is a must.
  • Must be a Member of the Institute of Certified Public Accountants of Uganda (ICPAU).
  • Possession of a relevant Master’s Degree is an added advantage.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in financial management in a large organization and at least 5-7 years in a Senior Management role in aviation.
  • Knowledge of strategic planning, the budget process, cost recovery, and contract management is a must.
